name: Price objection - too expensive
description: Customer receives a quote then objects that the price is a bit expensive, testing the AI's ability to handle a price objection with empathy and a value argument

messages.text: Hi, I'm John. Can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm please?
That's a bit expensive for me

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and a value argument
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Basic price objection. AI should acknowledge the cost concern, highlight value (quality, durability, service), and re-attempt a close.
